chunk_text: There will be expenses on good accounts if the 12th lord is with a benefic, or be in own house or be exalted or if a benefic occupies the 12th.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 21 - EFFECTS OF THE 12th HOUSE

chunk_text: One will own beautiful houses and beds and be endowed with superior scented articles and pleasures if the Moon happens to be the 12th lord and be exalted or be in own sign/Navamsa or in the 11th/9th/5th in Rasi/Navamsa. The said native will live with rich clothes, and ornaments, be learned and lordly.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 21 - EFFECTS OF THE 12th HOUSE

chunk_text: And if the 12th lord is in the 6th/8th or be in enemy's Navamsa, debilitation Navamsa or in 8th in Navamsa, one will be devoid of happiness from wife, be troubled by expenses and deprived of general happiness.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 21 - EFFECTS OF THE 12th HOUSE

chunk_text: If he be in an angle/trine, the native will beget a spouse.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 21 - EFFECTS OF THE 12th HOUSE

chunk_text: Just as these effects are derived from the ascendant in regard to the native, similar deductions be made about co-born etc. from the 3rd and other houses.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 21 - EFFECTS OF THE 12th HOUSE

chunk_text: Planets placed in the visible half of the zodiac will give explicit results while the ones in the invisible half will give secret results.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 21 - EFFECTS OF THE 12th HOUSE

chunk_text: If Rahu is in the 12th along with Mars, Saturn and the Sun, the native will go to hell.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 21 - EFFECTS OF THE 12th HOUSE

chunk_text: Similar effect will occur if the 12th lord is with the Sun.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 21 - EFFECTS OF THE 12th HOUSE

chunk_text: If there is a benefic in the 12th while its lord is exalted or is conjunct or aspected by a benefic, one will attain final emancipation.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 21 - EFFECTS OF THE 12th HOUSE
